name.en: R5Reloaded / Apex Season 3 — source-informed OntoUML v0.2

description.en: Static inspection of public R5 SDK and Flowstate source targeting R5pc_r5launch_N1094_CL456479_2019_10_30_05_20_PM. Source structures and script behavior inform this ontology; identities, stereotypes, and multiplicities remain interpretations. Native binary implementations and EA production matchmaking were not inspected.
An identified engine-side server resource, distinct from its hosting process and gameplay occurrences.

editorialNotes.en: OntoUML classification and multiplicities are modeling interpretations, not declarations recovered verbatim from C++ or scripts.

description.en: A conceptual identity for the current level and game roster. No literal match ID was recovered; the boundary is a modeling hypothesis.

editorialNotes.en: OntoUML classification and multiplicities are modeling interpretations, not declarations recovered verbatim from C++ or scripts.

description.en: A mode configuration artifact used by server and gameplay scripts; the exact file and override lifecycle is not reconstructed.

editorialNotes.en: OntoUML classification and multiplicities are modeling interpretations, not declarations recovered verbatim from C++ or scripts.

description.en: An identity distinguished by a platform/persona UID. Slot-local user IDs do not supply this identity. Real identities and placeholder bot IDs must be distinguished.

description.en: The remote game application as a runtime resource. Its process structure is abstracted rather than equated with CClient.

description.en: The opaque Pylon service endpoint reached by the SDK API client. Its internal objects, storage, and deployment are unresolved.

description.en: An identified advertisement information artifact describing a game server. It is separate from the server it describes.

description.en: A listing currently published through the directory service. Publication identity and lifecycle are conceptual abstractions.

description.en: The time-bounded publication relationship between a directory service and an advertised listing.

description.en: A listing whose intrinsic hidden field is true; retrieval can use a token. Offline hosting is the absence of a publication, not a listing phase.

description.en: A listing whose intrinsic hidden field is false.

description.en: An occurrence submitting host-listing data through PostServerHost; it may create or refresh an advertisement.

description.en: An occurrence querying a server list or looking up a listing by token. It does not itself establish a game connection.

description.en: A server-owned CClient resource/slot, reused across connection lifecycles. Neither the remote application nor an enduring player identity.

description.en: A client slot currently admitted to a game session. Continuity across reconnect or slot reuse is not presumed.

description.en: The current relationship between an admitted slot and one session. Historical player results require separate records.

description.en: A slot with sign-on state FULL, matching CClient::IsActive; this is distinct from avatar life state.

description.en: A CNetChan communication resource with endpoint and sequencing state. It can exist before a player entity is active.

description.en: Slot-specific replication/command state, modeled as an intrinsic mode rather than another player identity.

description.en: An identified player character entity. Script-level respawn can reuse its reference; native allocation and lifetime details remain unresolved.

description.en: A player entity assigned to a session participant; this role also permits fake-client participants.

editorialNotes.en: OntoUML classification and multiplicities are modeling interpretations, not declarations recovered verbatim from C++ or scripts.

description.en: The control relationship between one session participant and one assigned player entity. Exact allocation lifecycle is a hypothesis.

description.en: A session-scoped team/roster abstraction grounded in team numbers and team-based script operations.

description.en: A living player entity not in bleedout, using intrinsic life and bleedout state. This does not assert combat eligibility under every temporary effect.

description.en: A living player entity in bleedout. Alive and downed are not mutually exclusive raw engine predicates.

editorialNotes.en: OntoUML classification and multiplicities are modeling interpretations, not declarations recovered verbatim from C++ or scripts.

description.en: A platform identity with a current elimination status in this session. Source evidence is keyed by UID rather than entity life state.

description.en: The session-specific elimination relationship of a platform identity. The source implements its registry as information records.

description.en: The gameplay occurrence associated with a conceptual game session; not a literal SDK class.

description.en: One invocation of the visible server-frame entry point. Full simulation semantics are delegated to the binary.

description.en: An action-request information artifact represented by CUserCmd. Receiving it does not imply that it was processed.

description.en: An accepted movement-command execution passed to the native processor. Attempts rejected by the wrapper are distinct.
